display_name: 十三模型八种子：端到端推理时延、内存显存与FP32模型存储实测
description: Frozen E200 real checkpoints; synthetic CPU IQ to CPU labels, no dataset/truth/prediction scoring. GPU0 sequential fixed matrix.
authorization: 2026-10-12用户明确测量端到端时延、推理峰值内存/显存和模型存储大小，并加入已有Excel。

data.representation: 16 deterministic CPU FP32 unit-RMS IQ banks; input shape B×2×256; B=1/128
data.tx_sets_ref: ManySig.tx_list: all6; actual physical class strings exported at runtime
data.validation_ref: Original source data/checkpoint contracts reused; no target capsule opened

permissions.query_use: No query, source IQ, truth or scoring opened
permissions.claim_scope: Software CPU-IQ-to-CPU-label chain on desktop RTX3090; not physical RF/satellite end-to-end deployment

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-trained E200 checkpoints, exact architecture load
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Prior scratch source contracts verified; predict.check repeats exact source/provenance/freeze checks before use
checkpoint.selection_rule: All104 fixed rows; no candidate/seed selection, no training or target evaluation

execution.gpu_policy: GPU0 sequential one model process; abort unstarted rows if any foreign GPU0 process; never stop other owners
execution.stop_rule: Any failed row or foreign GPU0 interference => PARTIAL and no new rows; preserve all files, no automatic/score-based rerun

expected_artifacts: updated Excel with original12 sheets/images/charts preserved

metric_names: CPU inference-window sampled process peak RSS bytes

notes: One fresh worker per checkpoint; eval/no_grad; FP32/TF32off; 2 CPU threads; no training/optimization/export graph transformation.

E2E includes CPU contiguous/byte-buffer input, H2D, whole model including FFT, finite check, argmax, D2H labels and list construction. Excludes RF acquisition/synchronization front-end, filesystem, network and batching/queue wait.

Memory is measured separately after warmup/cache clearing. GPU allocated/reserved includes resident model plus inference workspace. CPU RSS sampling interval1ms; total process baseline includes Python/PyTorch/CUDA runtime; narrow spikes may be missed.

FP32 storage is actual uncompressed torch.save(state_dict) byte length incl buffers/serialization metadata, excluding optimizer, source checkpoint config, code and training history. In-memory serialized output is not a saved deployable model package.
Percentiles are per-checkpoint request distributions; final network percentile must pool equal-count request trials, not average percentiles. Across8-seed mean SD reported separately.
Existing historical RTX3090 timing/resources and accuracy preserved separately; new metrics do not replace or rescore them.
